touch.help: Walk with the left thumbstick. Drag across the view to look around. Use the buttons to run, jump and sit down. You can walk and look at the same time.
touch.standHint: Tap Stand up to get up.
touch.seated: You are sitting down. Tap Stand up to get up.
touch.trackWarning: Track area! Tap Climb up to get back onto the platform.

loading.title: Building the metro…
loading.note: Blasting the rock, casting the platforms and fitting the escalators.

driver.title: Driver mode
driver.intro: A practice train on its own track. W/S move the controller, E opens and closes the doors, Q ends. Stop with the front at the stop sign.
driver.introTouch: A practice train on its own track. Use + and − for the controller and Doors to open and close. Stop with the front at the stop sign.
driver.notHere: Driver mode starts from a platform.
driver.perfect: Perfect stop! {error} cm from the sign.
driver.good: Good stop, {error} cm from the sign.
driver.short: Too short, {error} m left to the sign.
driver.long: You ran {error} m past the sign.
driver.doorsFirst: Stop at the platform before you open the doors.
driver.doorsOpen: Close the doors before you drive.
driver.done: End of practice. {count} stops, {score} points of {max}.
driver.overrun: You ran past the platform. Practice stopped.

voices.hint: People around you speak their lines aloud in the browser’s Swedish voice. The captions show either way.

real.hint: The trains follow SL’s service live. A line SL sends no data for runs on the game’s own timetable.
real.on: The trains now follow SL live.
real.off: The trains follow the game’s own timetable.
real.failed: SL is not answering right now. The game’s own timetable is used meanwhile.
real.moved: The service changes over. You are on the platform.

era.to1975: It is 1975. The green trains roll, the signs click and nobody looks at a phone.

about.mitten: A blue mitten with a white cuff. The other one is surely still at some nursery school.
about.keys: A bunch of keys with a door fob. Someone is standing outside going through their pockets right now.
about.umbrella: Folded and dry. It was probably raining when its owner went down, but not when they came up.
about.teddy: A teddy bear with one ear more worn than the other. Someone misses it more than anything.
about.book: A dog-eared paperback. The bookmark is three chapters from the end.
about.sunglasses: A pair of sunglasses, dropped by someone who did not need them underground.
about.scarf: A striped scarf, knitted by hand. The fringe is cut unevenly.
about.hat: A green beanie with a bobble. It smells faintly of rain.
about.lunchbox: A lunch box with yesterday's pasta. Someone is eating out today.
about.phone: A mobile phone that rang on a bench. Its owner was so glad you answered.

lost.pick: Choose a thing to read about it.
lost.hint: Not found yet. People leave things on the benches, by the pillars and in the ticket halls, a few a day at every station.
lost.phoneHint: Not found yet. Once a day a phone rings on a bench somewhere in the metro.

discover.title: Discoveries
discover.intro: Everything that can happen down here. What you have not seen yet shows as a clue. Much depends on the time, the day and the weather, so come back another time. The clues are in Swedish.

life: A life on the blue line
support: Enjoying the game? Buy Joel a single ticket
feedback: Found a bug or have an idea? Email Joel

battery.hint: Easier on the computer: 30 frames a second and fewer pixels. Fans and battery will thank you.
battery.tip: Your computer seems to be struggling. Battery saver in the settings makes the game lighter.

crash.title: Something went wrong
crash.note: The game stopped. Reload and you will be back where you stood.
crash.subject: Under Stockholm: the game stopped
crash.body: What were you doing when it happened?

settings.title: Settings
settings.gamepad: Gamepad: left stick walks, right stick looks, A jumps, X uses, B sits, LB or pressing the left stick runs, Y shows the map, Start pauses.
